question: What do the discerning recognize this immersion to be?
premises: The preceding teaching describes an immersion grounded in the supreme will-power.
This immersion is a true means.
Those of refined understanding recognize it as the śāmbhava immersion.
inference: The discerning identify this will-grounded immersion as the śāmbhava means.
uncertainties: The phrase 'dwelling at the end of good understanding' is idiomatic and rendered functionally.
plain_english: Thus those of refined understanding know this true means, grounded in a portion of the supreme power of will, to be the immersion called śāmbhava.
